text_block_list.text:
I came to the cafeteria intending to grab 
lunch, but...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Chanko~♪ Chanko~♪ Grow big and strong, 
chan-chanko~♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~☆ This time, Maya's gonna aim to be 
a mature woman who can win your heart 
through your stomach~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~, Maya-chan is always saying "I 
wanna grow up fast"~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I think chanko nabe is the 
best choice~♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Perfection! The dish's name is super cute, 
too! My feminine charm just leveled up!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Gasp! That's right!! Maya is on a diet 
right now!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, what a shame~. Shall we just 
stick to cooking today, then?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Agreed☆ I'll go ask everyone to be taste 
testers!

"...And so, Mayano Top Gun's chanko nabe 
successfully won over everyone's 
stomachs!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe☆ Your cheeks are gonna drop right 
off! Look forward to it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Buono buono! Maya-chan, your cooking 
skills have gotten even better~

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~! Now all that's left is to capture 
Trainer-chan's stomach!

"...And so, the three of us thoroughly 
enjoyed the chanko nabe!"
